_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The score has not moved ±2+ points in 0 of 72 recent 12h windows — this is a confirmed coil where HOLD is the skilled, statistically honest default; the favorable macro undercurrent (weak dollar, fading BTC dominance, gold strength) supports an eventual UP break to Disbelief, but no directional breaker has been triggered yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial split — both place the market in Denial, but Analyst holds with low conviction citing broken internals while Narrative leans bullish with higher conviction citing macro tailwinds; the analyst's forward call predicts Disbelief but with a HOLD direction, while the narrative implies an UP break is brewing
next_move.confirmed_if: Score holds 55-62 for next 2-3 readings with funding sub-0.01% and VIX rangebound 13-16, OR VIX breaks below 12 with BTC exchange reserves dropping and CVD breaking above 40 (UP break to Hope)
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX >18 with funding >0.02% (breaks down to Anxiety/Complacency) OR score drops below 32 (collapse to Panic)
